messages:
Priya Singh: Opened a small PR to document resolver fallback and hostfile migration for Private installs in colo racks. Need: minimal CoreDNS example, short migration steps for /etc/hosts -> stub, and two smoke-test commands. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402 :mag:

docs-bot: PR created by Priya Singh: redwood-inference/docs #1402 (CI queued)

Marco Reyes: Core things to show: ordering (stub -> internal forwarders -> DoT upstream), minimal `denial` cache for kms names, note about systemd-resolved capturing port 53 on newer Ubuntu images.

Sam Wu: Proposed copyable CoreDNS snippet (for docs):
```
.:1053 {
  forward kms.internal 10.0.5.2 10.0.5.3
  forward . 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 tls_servername=dot.upstream.example
  cache { success 600 denial 20 }
  log
}
```

Sam Wu: Quick smoke tests to include:
`dig @127.0.0.1 -p 1053 kms.internal A`
`curl -v --resolve "control.private:443:10.0.1.10" https://control.private/health`

Marco Reyes: Add migration steps: 1) remove hosts entries, 2) enable `--use-stub-resolver` in installer, 3) apply CoreDNS forwarders, 4) run smoke tests and rollback host entries if unresolved. Link internal migration helper if available.

docs-bot: CI checks passed for #1402 - link/linters OK.

Priya Singh: Merged after small wording tweaks. Will follow up with changelog blurb referencing `--use-stub-resolver`. Closing thread.
